locator: Espay A.J.; et al. PLOS ONE 12(10):e0183989 (2017). DOI:10.1371/journal.pone.0183989

verified_scope: Abstract read: 9 ALS + 6 controls; twice-weekly home walking recordings for 24 weeks (4 weeks controls) with a foot-mounted IMU; walking-speed decline detected in 5/9 patients; validated against lab measurement.

title_or_artifact: Wearable Detection of Gait Changes in Walking Activities via Time Series Similarity Measures
verified_scope: Abstract read: detects abnormal walking patterns without prior knowledge of the individual using time-series similarity on 7 wearable devices; altered gait was INDUCED by unilateral weight addition and shoe elevation; >0.95 F1 over multiple steps.
limitations_or_next_action: Closest induced-perturbation gait-change-detection neighbour. CRITICAL distinction: its perturbations (added weight, shoe elevation) are intended as REAL gait changes to be detected, NOT as measurement-system perturbations to estimate integrity; no integrity estimator, no coverage/abstention, not plantar-pressure integrity. The candidate must explicitly distinguish measurement perturbation from biological perturbation. Does not kill the candidate.

title_or_artifact: Concurrent Validity and Test-Retest Reliability of Pressure-Detecting Insoles for Static and Dynamic Movements in Healthy Young Adults
verified_scope: Abstract/discussion read: reports ICC, SEM and MDC95 for pressure-insole vGRF; states MDC95 is the minimum change needed so a clinician can be 95% confident a change exceeds measurement error (i.e., is a true change, not measurement error).
limitations_or_next_action: MDC/SDC is the STANDARD statistical tool to separate true change from measurement error in insole research. It is a static, per-measurement threshold, not a measurement-integrity estimator, not longitudinal-attribution, and not abstention/coverage. It is the mandatory baseline the candidate must beat. Does not kill the candidate.

limitations_or_next_action: Kills 'multiaxial (normal+shear) in-socket sensing' as novel. Prosthetic-socket space occupied.

title_or_artifact: Impedance sensing device enables early detection of pressure ulcers in vivo
verified_scope: Abstract read: states no clinical method existed to detect progressive tissue damage before a surface wound is visible; a flexible IMPEDANCE device maps pressure-induced tissue damage even when not visually observable; argues direct tissue-status sensing beats the secondary proxy of applied pressure.
limitations_or_next_action: KEY: surface PRESSURE is an insufficient proxy for tissue damage; early-detection prior art uses IMPEDANCE, not pressure. A Velostat pressure array cannot do impedance/SpO2, so this unmet need is not reachable with the current hardware.

title_or_artifact: Wearable-device geometry and tissue mechanical variability determine sacral soft-tissue loading and pressure injury risk
verified_scope: Abstract read: surface pressure does not reflect internal (deep-tissue) strain; strain peaks in adipose/muscle near bony prominences even when surface pressure looks acceptable; calls for geometry-aware, deformation-based (not surface-pressure) risk assessment.
limitations_or_next_action: Confirms the recurring genuine gap (surface pressure cannot see deep-tissue injury) but it needs internal-strain estimation/deformation modelling, not a pressure array alone.

title_or_artifact: Combining wearable sensor signals, machine learning and biomechanics to estimate tibial bone force and damage during running
verified_scope: Abstract read: states current wearables do NOT estimate tissue-level loads inside the body; multi-sensor physics/ML algorithms estimate peak tibial force during running with 2.6-5.2% error vs conventional approaches.
limitations_or_next_action: A genuine gap (internal bone/tissue load) with a legible mechanism, but it needs force-plate/instrumented-treadmill ground truth and warns against inferring internal load from GRF. Not reachable without a reference.

title_or_artifact: SENSEI 'The Cast Master' - non-invasive compartment-pressure monitoring under an orthopedic cast
verified_scope: Document read: an 8-sensor sleeve under a cast continuously monitors compartment pressure and alerts in real time to acute compartment syndrome risk (threshold ~30 mmHg), replacing invasive measurement.
limitations_or_next_action: NON-ACADEMIC student venture doc. Kills 'under-cast compartment-pressure sensing + alert' as novel. Cast/compartment-syndrome space occupied.

title_or_artifact: A hybrid EMG-EEG interface for robust intention detection and fatigue-adaptive control of an elbow rehabilitation robot
verified_scope: Abstract/methods read: k-NN fatigue estimator on EMG spectral features feeds a Bayesian fusion that re-weights EMG vs EEG in real time; preserves 91.4% vs 83.1% accuracy under high fatigue; <500 ms latency.
limitations_or_next_action: Occupies direction B (fatigue-aware adaptive control) and part of C (intention detection). Fatigue is detected in real time and control adapts. Not novel.

title_or_artifact: Hybrid EMG-NMES control for real-time muscle fatigue reduction in bionic hands
verified_scope: Abstract read: SVM fatigue detection (95.4%) + fuzzy grip; closed-loop NMES reduces fatigue 28.6%; deployed on sbRIO embedded platform.
limitations_or_next_action: Occupies direction B on embedded hardware. Fatigue detection + adaptive actuation already done. Not novel.

title_or_artifact: Controlling a motorized orthosis to follow elbow volitional movement: tests with individuals with pathological tremor
locator: Journal of NeuroEngineering and Rehabilitation 16:15 (2019). DOI:10.1186/s12984-019-0484-1
verified_scope: Abstract/methods read: the orthosis tracks the voluntary component (from a force signal) and rejects the tremor band (2-10 Hz) as a disturbance.
limitations_or_next_action: Occupies direction C (voluntary vs involuntary separation for assistive control) via frequency-band rejection. Not novel.

title_or_artifact: Multimodal Movement Prediction - Towards an Individual Assistance of Patients
verified_scope: Abstract read: combines EEG readiness potential + EMG + eye fixation + force; an AND-combination is proposed specifically to distinguish voluntary from involuntary movement so the assistive device is not triggered by involuntary motion.
limitations_or_next_action: Occupies direction C and touches D (assist triggered by detected intention). Distinguishing voluntary vs involuntary to gate assistance is already proposed. Not novel.

title_or_artifact: MISC: Minimal Intervention Shared Control with Guaranteed Safety under Non-Convex Constraints
verified_scope: Abstract read: a constraint-aware assistive controller that MINIMALLY perturbs the user's input to keep safety constraints, with control-invariant-set guarantees.
limitations_or_next_action: Occupies directions E and the user's earlier #1 (minimum-intervention corrective guidance). 'Minimally adjust user input' is an established shared-control formulation. Not novel.

title_or_artifact: A Review of Intent Detection, Arbitration, and Communication Aspects of Shared Control for Physical Human-Robot Interaction
verified_scope: Abstract read: systematizes intent detection + arbitration + feedback; describes minimal assist-as-needed (mAAN) controllers that provide the least assistance while guaranteeing the human completes the task.
limitations_or_next_action: Establishes minimum-assistance / assist-as-needed as a mature framework. Direction E is a named, reviewed paradigm. Not novel.

title_or_artifact: An assistive robot that enables people with amyotrophia to perform sequences of everyday activities
verified_scope: Abstract read: EDAN robot for severe motor impairment; sEMG interface decodes 3D continuous commands + trigger from residual muscle activity, with shared control; notes fatigue and involuntary contractions degrade the interface over long use.
limitations_or_next_action: Occupies direction A (adaptive residual-control interface for motor disability). Residual-signal control interfaces are mature. Not novel.

title_or_artifact: Adaptive Neural Decoder for Prosthetic Hand Control
verified_scope: Abstract read: an adaptive motor decoder that auto-switches algorithms in real time to track the amputee's changing biological state, explicitly to avoid frequent recalibration and preserve long-term control integrity.
limitations_or_next_action: KEY: adaptive/online re-calibration of a control interface against signal degradation is already done and framed as 'long-term integrity of control'. This is the control-interface analogue of the measurement-integrity mechanism.

title_or_artifact: Examination of the Performance Characteristics of Velostat as an In-Socket Pressure Sensor
locator: Hopkins M.; et al. IEEE (2020); DOI/record 9024130; https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/document/9024130/
verified_scope: Abstract read: Velostat accuracy errors 16-48% FSO; cyclic drift up to 0.00715 V/cycle; static drift up to 1.17%/min; hysteresis up to 7.25% FSO; thermal variation up to 67% of voltage range; temperature relationship differs per sensor so no single compensation model fits all; notes per-sensor calibration is impractical for large arrays.
limitations_or_next_action: Benchmark of Velostat failure modes. Confirms: (1) failure modes are large and varied; (2) per-sensor calibration of big arrays is impractical -> opens the redundancy/self-diagnosis angle. Author list partial.

title_or_artifact: A Velostat-Based Pressure-Sensitive Mat for Center-of-Pressure Measurements: A Preliminary Study
locator: Martinez-Cesteros I.; et al. IJERPH 18(11):5958 (2021). DOI:10.3390/ijerph18115958
verified_scope: Abstract read: homemade Velostat PSM vs commercial mat vs force plate for CoP in 42 volunteers; low-cost PSMs suffer noise, non-repeatability, crosstalk; creep/hysteresis compensation models reduce error.
limitations_or_next_action: Establishes Velostat PSM for CoP/balance and that creep/hysteresis compensation exists. Posture/CoP mat applications are occupied; compensation is model-based, not cause-diagnosis.

title_or_artifact: Examination of the performance characteristics of Velostat as an in-socket pressure sensor
locator: Hopkins M.; Vaidyanathan R.; McGregor A.H. IEEE Sensors Journal 20(12):6992-7000 (2020). DOI:10.1109/JSEN.2020.2978431
verified_scope: Full abstract read: Velostat in-socket sensor; accuracy errors 16-48% FSO; cyclic drift 0.00715 V/cycle; static drift 1.17%/min; thermal swing up to 67%; hysteresis 7.25% FSO. Authors conclude Velostat 'requires significant improvement in its electrical properties before proving suitable for accurate pressure measurement' and that per-sensor calibration/modeling is impractical for large arrays.
limitations_or_next_action: ANCHOR prior art: confirms Velostat-in-socket exists AND that its reliability is an OPEN, author-acknowledged gap. The candidate attacks exactly this gap using cheapness (redundancy) instead of per-sensor modeling.

title_or_artifact: Sandia three-axis (normal + 2 shear) in-socket pressure sensor in a liner (patented)

title_or_artifact: Smart Transfemoral Prosthetic Socket with Motorized Cable-Driven System

limitations_or_next_action: Prior art: closed-loop smart socket with FSR exists. Uses external calibration; does not self-diagnose drift. Reinforces that the reliability/self-calibration angle is the differentiator.

title_or_artifact: Efficient Calibration of Velostat-Based Flexible Pressure Sensor Matrix

verified_scope: Abstract read: 2N parameters calibrate an NxN Velostat matrix (vs 2N^2); 32x32 mat, 4.2% mean error vs 35 participants' weight; distinguishes possible foot ulcers / flat feet. STATIC manufacturing calibration for a plantar mat.
limitations_or_next_action: NOT the mechanism: static parameter-efficient calibration, not runtime cause-diagnosis. Does not kill the candidate but must be cited.

title_or_artifact: Streamlined custom manufacturing for optimized 3D printed prostheses through 3D pressure mapping
locator: Biosensors and Bioelectronics (2026); PII S0956566326001922 (Simon Fraser University)
verified_scope: Abstract read: wearable liner with 3D-printed origami capacitive sensors maps limb-socket pressure to design a density-graded 3D-printed socket; notes liner slippage and sensor position drift as remaining error sources.
limitations_or_next_action: Prior art: pressure-mapping liner for socket design exists; explicitly lists sensor drift/slippage as unsolved. Supports the reliability gap.

title_or_artifact: Adaptive Calibration of Piezoresistive Pressure Sensors Across Variable Sensor Sizes
locator: Aisuwarya R.; Jing L. IEEE MCSoC 2025:622-627. DOI:10.1109/MCSoC67473.2025.00102
verified_scope: Abstract/record read: calibration method that adapts to variable sensor sizes (Velostat-class piezoresistive); a calibration methodology, not runtime failure diagnosis.
limitations_or_next_action: Second-nearest prior art. Static/adaptive CALIBRATION, not runtime self-diagnosis of failure cause. Must be cited; does not kill the candidate.

title_or_artifact: A piezoresistive tactile sensor (16-element array with temperature compensation)
verified_scope: Abstract read: 16-element piezoresistive tactile array; each sensing element paired with a 'dummy gauge' in a Wheatstone half-bridge to provide temperature compensation and reduce thermal error.
limitations_or_next_action: IMPORTANT precedent: reference/'dummy' element for temperature compensation is a classic strain-gauge technique. The 'reference-cell for temperature' piece of the mechanism is NOT new; only the multi-cause active diagnosis + perturbation-injection is.

title_or_artifact: A Hybrid-Frequency Sampling Tactile Sensing System Based on a Flexible Piezoresistive Sensor Array
verified_scope: Abstract read: FPGA-based piezoresistive (Velostat) tactile array; explicitly notes Velostat 'exhibits inevitable temporal drift in absolute resistance, but the relative variation in channel responses is sufficiently stable' -> uses RELATIVE dynamics to be robust to drift.
limitations_or_next_action: Adjacent drift-robustness approach: uses relative (not absolute) sensing to tolerate drift, but does NOT diagnose or correct the drift cause. Must be cited as alternative strategy; does not kill the candidate.
